rationale: GHI #754. Pre-ledger advisory-scorecard coverage is real but unattributable: rows exist for these rules, but nothing recorded which rule-version they were written against, so no reader can tell a current row from a stale one. Stamping them all as reviewed-at-current-version would launder exactly the unreviewed coverage this audit exists to surface, so today debt is frozen at today versions instead (the data/fidelity_presence_grandfather.json precedent, ADR-0.0.73 OBPI-08). The freeze is version-pinned: a grandfathered rule that is edited leaves its pin behind and must be scored for real. Debt cannot grow and cannot follow a rule forward silently. tests.md and task-discovery.md are deliberately absent - they carried the two drifts GHI #754 found and were scored for real at landing.
